title: Rav Huna bar Abba
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in the old Tanchuma, Tetzaveh, saying: “When the sacrifices were offered,” etc. Hyman calls this a scribal error and proposes Rav Chiyya bar Abba, as in Tanchuma Buber, end of Tetzaveh, and so it is in Peah, chapter 7, halakhah 3.

notes.text: The consulted standard Tanchuma names Rav Huna bar Abba in the grain-yield passage. Buber’s Tanchuma names R. Chiyya bar Abba, and Yerushalmi Peah 7:3 gives Rabbi Chiyya bar Ba in the grain parallel.
